name: Clare Monroe
source:
Mom has always taken care of us to the best of her ability. I've heard she's very popular among celebrities as well.
Probably a big reason as to why the modelling agency is doing so well, everyones knows and trust her.
And there's just something about her that's strangely beautiful... I know she's my mom but I can't help thinking about it.

[In game description]
